note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Internal audit found 40 payments totalling $312,000 to a supplier whose bank account matches an employee's.

answers.common.decision: Whether to open a formal investigation and what to preserve; the general counsel decides.
answers.common.materials: 36 of the payments were approved by the same manager. Every invoice was below the $10,000 approval limit. Our total spend in that supplier's category was $1,560,000 over the same period.
answers.financial-crime.case: Supplier payments flagged by internal audit, under our fraud response policy.
answers.financial-crime.decider: The general counsel decides any conclusion about individuals and next steps.
